description.p: Salt is a fast, open-source bootstrapper for running Roblox Studio on Linux, written in Rust. It is a rewrite of Vinegar by VinegarHQ and shares its data and configuration.
With Virtual Desktops on, Studio's login window no longer stays blank when it opens behind other windows, and typing in it no longer lags by seconds: its web pages now draw in software there.
Studio's login window and other web pages use about half the memory: WebView2's processes now share its 300 MB library instead of each loading a copy.
Stopping Salt with Virtual Desktops on now also stops Studio, which was left running.

Settings are safer: the Virtual Desktop size is only saved once it is a whole resolution, reverting the Wine setting no longer deletes the downloaded Wine, a mistyped forced version no longer removes the installed Studio, and an unreadable config.toml is kept instead of being overwritten.
Salt follows the desktop's GTK 4 theme colors.
Salt now updates itself: when Studio starts, it installs any newer release in the background and uses it from the next launch. Turn it off with the Automatic Updates setting.
Salt can also be installed from a mirror with one command that works in any shell.
When Studio closes, Salt now stops the Wine processes left behind (crash handler, WebView2, StudioMCP), which could keep hundreds of MB in use.
The MCP bridge reconnects when the Salt hosting StudioMCP exits, instead of hanging every tool call.
Studio starts faster: Wine boots once, alongside the update check, instead of twice.
Lost DNS replies are resent after 1 second instead of 5.
Dark mode: an Appearance setting (Automatic, Light or Dark) for Salt and its settings window.
The icon in Salt's title bars always contrasts with the title bar, even when the taskbar icon is set to white.
The logo inside Salt's windows now always contrasts with the window background, and a "Salt Settings" entry opens the settings from any app launcher.
New app icon in black and white versions, following the desktop's light or dark theme, with a setting to choose one manually.
Rewrite of Vinegar in Rust: faster setup and installs, Studio logs read from files instead of Wine's debug channel, fixes for DNS stalls and log spam, and an MCP bridge for Roblox Studio.
